title: Notes
body:
Notes is a super handy app to quickly write things down. You can use it for school, lists, ideas, or reminders, and everything stays neatly saved.

It’s easy to use and you can organise your notes in folders, which helps when you have a lot of them. You can also add pictures, checklists, and sometimes even drawings ✍️

It works smoothly and syncs well between devices if you use Apple.

Downside is that it’s pretty simple, so it doesn’t have super advanced features like some other apps

title: Recommandations
body:
L’application me sert régulièrement dans mes études.
Elle réunit plusieurs caractéristiques que je recherche à savoir, simplicité, ergonomie et continuité avec l’écosystème de produits Apple.

Néanmoins, laissez-moi vous donner quelques recommandations d’amélioration envisageable :

• Option pour scinder une note en plusieurs pages distinctes.

• Option de zoom.

• Option de format de papier (utile pour les notes à imprimer) : A4, A3,…

• Option de « magnétisme » pour pouvoir accrocher les points d’une forme à la grille.

title: Huge bug makes your notes disappear
body: If you’re writing anything in quick notes mode (small window on the side of the screen, not directly on the note app), don’t you dare ever closing or changing page or even just hiding the note w/o even closing. 1/3 times you’ll loose half of your lasts words/drawing/notes as if you never wrote them. + you can’t zoom in or out, move as much as you want on the sides, move at all to the sides actually, so obviously if ever you took notes (in quick notes modes still) in a « larger window » and hide it to the side, it might open next side in a smaller window but not zoomed out, so all your notes on the right side will be gone for ever. Sometimes if you’re lucky enough, the right side of the note could come back in the actual note app. But never the words on the bottom that disappeared for ever. What’s the point of « quick note » mode if it’s to delete half your work ? Also, the pen case is boring at, you can’t rearrange pens and colors the way you use them the most, nor add more of same pens w/ ≠ colors for a quicker note taking.
author: Salemystic

title: What a love of Notes
body:
This application is quite useful, I can work in any moment of the day and in any place.

What is awesome is 

- the possibility of drawing with fingers
- paste web links
- paste photos or any other image
- send the information at my email
- send any kind of text from Notes to any other web connection. 
- use some cells for any propose like for example a lecture, conference or speech

Could Appel do better ? Steve Jobs will always ask for a better performance of your work ;-) 

- could someone paste a video at Notes ? I do not try it yet
- could someone edit a video at Notes?  Same answer, I don’t try it yet
- These two possibilities worth it ? May be not
- could we use some Artificial Intelligence tools with Notes contents? Why not ? What about translation? Erasing the background of a photo etc? 

In any case, I love this app.
